adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` call is wrapped in a `try/catch` that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and then continues to return `{ message: "Guests added" }` (i.e., success) even if all email sending fails. This is verifiable in the diff and creates an observability/reliability gap for the new feature (no error propagation, no logging of the actual error, no signal to callers). The claim about “no test” isn’t directly provable from the diff alone, but the swallowed-error behavior is.
